image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a ceramic mug filled with dark liquid (likely coffee). The mug has an off-white/cream glazed body and a contrasting brown/tan handle and rim. The background is a plain, out-of-focus white/light gray surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup/mug and not a similar vessel like a bowl or pitcher.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle-to-body connection, a common failure point in AI generation (floating or fused handles).
To ensure the liquid surface sits correctly within the rim geometry without bleeding or perspective errors.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the glaze or unnatural blurring in the specular highlights.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the main body; AI often fails to render the negative space inside the handle loop or fuses the handle incorrectly. Also, verify that the dark liquid does not 'bleed' into the ceramic rim.
